# Regulatory Overlay Type

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:RegulatoryOverlayType`](gmeow-RegulatoryOverlayType.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/RegulatoryOverlayType>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The kind of a regulatory overlay (zoning, protected area, restricted airspace, sanctions, tax district, electoral district, postal zone, civil-time zone, …). A value, not a subclass: the set is open-ended and they share all of [`RegulatoryOverlay`](gmeow-RegulatoryOverlay.md)'s structure, so a new kind is a new individual, not a new class ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:RegulatoryOverlayType`](gmeow-RegulatoryOverlayType.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to mint a new kind of regulatory overlay as an individual on the open value vocabulary (zoning, maritime, aviation, …).

### Avoid when

- Avoid subclassing [`RegulatoryOverlay`](gmeow-RegulatoryOverlay.md) for a new kind ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).

### How to use

- Mint the kind as a [`gmeow:RegulatoryOverlayType`](gmeow-RegulatoryOverlayType.md) individual and reference it from an overlay via [`gmeow:overlayType`](../properties/gmeow-overlayType.md).

### Examples

- ex:overlayTypeFloodZone a [`gmeow:RegulatoryOverlayType`](gmeow-RegulatoryOverlayType.md).
